profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | C++ Systems | Backend & Infrastructure | Distributed & Real-Time Systems | Performance Engineering
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 10 years of experience building high-performance C++ systems across autonomous vehicles and cloud-connected platforms.
My work focuses on performance-critical infrastructure including real-time data pipelines, telemetry and diagnostics systems, and large-scale sensor processing platforms. I have extensive experience with C++, Linux, multithreading, and performance optimization in systems where reliability and latency are critical.
At Aurora, I develop infrastructure for processing high-throughput LiDAR and camera sensor streams used in autonomous vehicle localization and perception. My work includes designing fault-tolerant monitoring systems, improving observability through telemetry and diagnostics pipelines, and optimizing performance in real-time processing environments.
Previously I worked at Amazon developing diagnostics and telemetry frameworks for heterogeneous device platforms, and at Northrop Grumman building real-time targeting systems where I optimized algorithms using CUDA GPU acceleration.
Core interests:
• High-performance systems
• Infrastructure and distributed systems
• Real-time data pipelines
• Performance optimization
• C++ and Linux systems engineering
Interested in infrastructure, distributed systems, and performance-critical backend roles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on infrastructure for processing high-throughput sensor data used in autonomous vehicle localization and perception.
Key work includes:
• Led integration of sensor platforms across multiple generations of autonomous vehicle hardware, defining interfaces between perception, platform, and hardware systems
• Developed high-throughput C++ data pipelines processing LiDAR streams with tens of thousands of readings per second for real-time localization and perception
• Optimized sensor processing performance, including CRC computation improvements that reduced processing time by 38%.
• Built camera ingestion and processing infrastructure supporting perception pipelines across multi-sensor autonomous vehicle platforms
• Designed fault-tolerant sensor health monitoring systems to maintain perception reliability in adverse environments
• Improved observability through telemetry, diagnostics, and logging pipelines for sensor processing systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of an extensible device diagnostics and performance monitoring framework enabling rapid root-cause analysis across heterogeneous device platforms
• Designed and implemented cross-platform C++ libraries and APIs supporting both bare-metal and embedded Linux systems
• Built logging and telemetry pipelines for device health monitoring, enabling large-scale performance analysis and remote debugging across heterogeneous device platforms.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed embedded Linux C++ software for the next-generation Litening targeting pod supporting air-to-air and air-to-ground target detection and tracking
• Led development of pilot interface software and real-time communication infrastructure between sensor subsystems and aircraft avionics
• Built and optimized real-time image processing and tracking pipelines, improving frame analysis performance through GPU acceleration using CUDA.
• Integrated software across hardware subsystems including device drivers, sensors, and avionics interfaces

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed embedded C/C++ software for bare-metal and embedded Linux platforms across industrial, medical, and consumer products
• Delivered end-to-end engineering consulting for client products including system architecture, firmware development, and product integration.
• Collaborated directly with client teams to scope projects, define technical requirements, and deliver production-ready systems
